name: Pipeline health
description: Run history, row counts, dbt results and unmapped values. Internal only.

cards.text: **Pipeline health. Internal, never share this dashboard.** Run history and row counts per source come from `ops.ingest_runs`, dbt results from `ops.dbt_runs`, and the values the seeds miss from the `qa` views.

cards.title: Newest successful load
cards.description: The newest run_date any source loaded successfully. It should be today once the daily run is done.

cards.title: Failed loads, last 30 days
cards.description: Loads in ops.ingest_runs with status failed.

cards.title: dbt problems in the newest build
cards.description: Nodes that warned, failed or errored in the newest build of each dbt step.

cards.title: Sources
cards.description: Each source as of its newest successful run. Freshness warns at 26 hours since the load and errors at 50.

cards.title: Postings parsed per source
cards.description: Postings parsed from the newest load of each day. The volume test fails a day below half the 7 day average.

cards.title: Loads, last 30 days
cards.description: Every load in ops.ingest_runs from the last 30 days, newest first.

cards.title: Test results per day
cards.description: Data tests and freshness checks by result, for the newest build of each step on each day.

cards.title: Problems in the newest build
cards.description: What warned, failed or errored in the newest build of each dbt step.

cards.title: Unmapped locations
cards.description: Locations no alias in city_aliases.csv matches, so the city is Unknown. Remote postings are left out.

cards.title: Unclassified titles
cards.description: Titles no rule in role_family_rules.csv matches, so the role family is other.

cards.title: Salary parse failures
cards.description: Salary texts that gave no monthly amount, with the reason.
